note: Canonical dataset. README tables, badge-freshness.json and the interactive site are all generated from this file — do not hand-edit them. `verified: true` means the core facts (tier, limits, key catch, link) were independently confirmed against the provider's own docs on `last_verified`. `verified: false` means sourced from community tracking and not yet independently re-confirmed here — treat those as indicative. Attribute fields (openai_compatible, modalities, best_for) are progressively backfilled and may be null.

providers.name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio)
providers.free_tier: Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro (limited), embeddings, TTS models
providers.rate_limits: Per-model; Google no longer publishes the free-tier numbers in its public docs — they are shown only on the AI Studio rate-limit page after sign-in
providers.notes: Free-tier prompts/outputs may be used by Google to improve its products outside the UK/CH/EEA/EU. Since the 2026-03-23 terms, only Paid Services may serve API clients to end users in the EEA/CH/UK
providers.best_for: The only frontier-class model with a genuine free tier

providers.name: Groq
providers.free_tier: Open-weight models (GPT-OSS, Qwen) plus Whisper, no credit card required
providers.rate_limits: Free plan examples: openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b and qwen/qwen3.8-27b: 30 RPM/1K RPD/8K TPM/200K TPD; Whisper models: 20 RPM/2K RPD/7.2K audio seconds/hour and 28.8K/day; limits vary by model
providers.notes: Limits apply at the organization level, not per API key. Phone verification required at signup
providers.best_for: Lowest-latency inference for open-weight models

free_limits.scope: free plan, each of openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b and qwen/qwen3.8-27b; limits vary by model

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_tier: A rotating set of models with a :free suffix (16 on 2026-10-08; count fluctuates), single API across many providers
providers.rate_limits: 20 req/min; 50 req/day under 10 credits purchased lifetime, 1000 req/day once 10+ credits purchased (one-time, not a subscription)
providers.notes: ToS (Jul 2026) prohibits reselling API access or building a competing service — platform-wide, not just the free models; per-model terms still apply
providers.best_for: Widest model selection behind one no-card key

free_limits.scope: free models, accounts with under 10 credits purchased lifetime (1,000 requests/day once 10+ credits are purchased); table not readable in a plain fetch, figures are those of the entry's own verification

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free_tier: 10,000 Neurons/day, all account plans
providers.rate_limits: 10,000 Neurons/day (free allocation). Per-task request limits: text generation 300 requests/min (models that require Workers Paid: 20 requests/min per model); text embeddings 3,000/min; speech recognition, text-to-image, translation, image-to-text 720/min
providers.notes: Resets daily at 00:00 UTC; overage on a Workers Paid plan bills at $0.011/1,000 Neurons. A few models (e.g. Kimi K2.6/K2.7-code, GLM-5.2) now require a Workers Paid plan
providers.best_for: Highest free daily volume for a real side project

free_limits.scope: text generation; models that require Workers Paid: 20 requests/minute per model. The daily allowance is 10,000 Neurons, a unit that is not requests or tokens

providers.name: Cohere
providers.free_tier: Trial (evaluation) API keys covering chat, embed and rerank
providers.rate_limits: 1,000 API calls/month total; 20 req/min chat; 2,000 inputs/min embed; 10 req/min rerank
providers.notes: Explicitly for evaluation only — Cohere's terms prohibit production/commercial use on a trial key
providers.best_for: Free embeddings and rerank for RAG prototypes

free_limits.scope: trial key, chat endpoint; 1,000 API calls per month in total

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.free_tier: $5 in free credits for new accounts, usable across all public models
providers.rate_limits: Published Free Trial limits for gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b: 5 RPM / 30,000 uncached TPM / 90,000 total TPM / 1,000,000 TPH / 1,000,000 TPD; limits vary by model
providers.notes: A verified payment method is required to activate Playground/API access (no charge until you buy credits). Credits expire 30 days after grant; whether any free access persists past expiry is not stated
providers.best_for: Fastest tokens/sec on wafer-scale hardware

providers.name: Mistral (La Plateforme)
providers.free_tier: "Free mode" (default for new accounts): API keys with included monthly usage and the lowest limits, "intended for evaluation and prototyping"
providers.rate_limits: Not published publicly; per-model requests/second, tokens/minute and tokens/month caps are shown only in-console (Admin Panel > API > Limits)
providers.notes: No credit card required. In Free mode Mistral may use your inputs and outputs to train its models unless you opt out in the Admin panel. Phone verification at signup was recorded in an earlier check; the current docs do not mention it.
providers.best_for: European models to prototype against before upgrading

providers.name: HuggingFace
providers.free_tier: Free CPU Basic + ZeroGPU for Spaces; Inference Providers has no included credit on the Free plan (credits must be purchased) — $2.00/mo is included only on PRO/Team/Enterprise
providers.rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published, only credit amounts
providers.notes: Credits only apply with "Routed by Hugging Face" billing, not with a Custom Provider Key
providers.best_for: Router access to many open-weight providers under one key

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.free_tier: China platform (siliconflow.cn): several models permanently free at ¥0 (e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B, BAAI embeddings and rerankers). The international platform (siliconflow.com) lists no $0 LLMs and gives $1 in free credits instead
providers.rate_limits: Fixed per-model limits for free models; generic docs cite ranges of 1,000-10,000 RPM and 50,000-5,000,000 TPM depending on model tier — exact limits shown in-account
providers.notes: Free models live on the China platform and need real-name authentication to use all of them; accepted documents are a mainland ID card, HK/Macao or Taiwan travel permits, HK/Macao/Taiwan residence permits or a Chinese permanent-residence card for foreigners. Signup is by phone number; some virtual-carrier number ranges are blocked.
providers.best_for: Permanently-free open models, no trial clock

providers.name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI / GLM)
providers.free_tier: GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash (text), and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) are officially listed as $0 cost (input, cached input, and output) on a permanent basis
providers.rate_limits: Not specified with concrete RPM/TPM figures in public docs
providers.notes: Terms of Use prohibit using Z.ai to "develop, train, or enhance any algorithms, models, or technologies that directly or indirectly compete with us" — otherwise general use, including commercial, isn't restricted
providers.best_for: A permanently-free model with no trial clock

providers.name: IBM watsonx.ai (Lite plan)
providers.free_tier: Lite plan: 300,000 tokens/month for foundation model inference, 20 CUH/month for ML tooling, 100 pages/month of document text extraction
providers.rate_limits: 2 inference requests per second (explicitly documented for the Lite plan)
providers.notes: Lite plan doesn't support fine-tuning of foundation or custom models; 1-day idle deployment timeout. Never expires or bills while inside quota, but a payment method (with a nominal ~$1 authorization hold) is required at signup
providers.best_for: Governed enterprise inference with a monthly free quota

free_limits.scope: Lite plan: 2 inference requests per second; 300,000 tokens per month for foundation model inference; not re-read in a plain fetch, figures are those of the entry's own verification

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.free_tier: Seven models are currently listed as Free: two Qwen3Guard moderation models, Stable Diffusion XL and four NVIDIA Riva TTS voices; access is available anonymously or with an API key tied to a Public Cloud project
providers.rate_limits: Anonymous access: 2 requests/min per IP per model. Authenticated (API key): 400 requests/min per project per model. Exceeding either returns HTTP 429
providers.notes: European provider (France), relevant for EU data-sovereignty/GDPR-conscious use. The authenticated tier needs a valid payment method on the project (though "Free" models themselves don't charge); anonymous access needs neither an account nor a card. A separate general $200 Public Cloud trial voucher also exists but is unrelated to this free-model tier
providers.best_for: EU-hosted, no-account access to open models

free_limits.scope: anonymous access, per IP and per model. With an API access key the page gives 400 requests per minute per Public Cloud project and per model, but the getting-started guide says keys from projects without a payment method (Discovery mode) cannot use the service, so that figure needs a project with a payment method

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.free_tier: $1 trial credit
providers.rate_limits: 10 requests/min with no payment method or no credits; 6,000 RPM account-wide maximum once a payment method and active credits are on file
providers.notes: Fireworks uses prepaid credits. After the $1 credit is exhausted, add a payment method and credits (or enable auto top-up) to continue; account limits can rise with spend
providers.best_for: Fast hosted open models to trial with $1

providers.name: Baseten
providers.free_tier: New accounts receive free credits; Baseten's current pricing page does not state the amount
providers.rate_limits: Model APIs default (models with combined token limits): Basic (unverified) 15 RPM / 100,000 TPM; Basic (verified) 120 RPM / 500,000 TPM; HTTP 429 when exceeded
providers.notes: Basic is $0/month, pay as you go. Current pricing confirms new-account credits but does not publish an amount or expiration date. Model APIs are priced per token; dedicated deployments are priced by compute time.
providers.best_for: Free starter credits for evaluating hosted custom and open models

providers.name: Nebius AI Studio
providers.free_tier: $1 trial credit, valid for 30 days
providers.rate_limits: Default per-account RPM/TPM caps are shown in the Token Factory console and in response headers (not stated numerically in the docs; the docs' 60 RPM / 400,000 TPM baseline is labeled an illustrative example). Limits auto-scale: +20% per 15-minute window at >=80% usage, up to 20x the base
providers.notes: Product renamed to "Nebius Token Factory"; a bank card is required to set up billing
providers.best_for: Cheap open-model inference after a $1 trial

providers.name: Novita AI
providers.free_tier: $100 promotional credits valid for 90 days for eligible Novita Agent Sandbox usage (CPU, RAM, storage), granted after an account-setup survey; Novita does not say they apply to Model API calls; the pricing page also lists a few LLMs as Free (e.g. Ling 3.1 Flash, Apodex 1.1 Mini)
providers.rate_limits: Per model, by account tier. New/low-spend accounts are Tier T1 (monthly top-ups <= $50): typically 30 RPM and 50M TPM per model (a few models 50 RPM; some 2M-5M TPM). The Free-priced LLMs (Ling 3.1 Flash, Apodex 1.1 Mini) are 30 RPM / 50M TPM at T1
providers.notes: Signup advertises $100 Sandbox credits valid for 90 days; Novita's sandbox pricing doc describes them as credits for "eligible Novita Sandbox usage" and does not say they apply to Model API calls. No credit card required. Novita Terms of Service state that the Site and Marketplace Offerings may not be exploited for any commercial purpose without express prior written permission.
providers.best_for: $100 credits for Novita Agent Sandbox; a few LLMs priced Free on Model APIs

providers.name: AI21 Labs
providers.free_tier: $10 trial credit, valid 3 months
providers.rate_limits: Jamba Large/Mini: 10 RPS / 200 RPM by default
providers.notes: Card not required for the trial credit itself, required once it expires
providers.best_for: Jamba long-context models on a $10 trial

providers.name: NLP Cloud
providers.free_tier: $15 trial credit
providers.rate_limits: Variable by model, no numeric RPM/TPM published
providers.notes: Corrected: the official registration page does not ask for a phone number, contradicting the earlier listing
providers.best_for: NLP tasks (NER, classification, summarization) on a $15 trial

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio)
providers.free_tier: Typically 1,000,000 tokens per model for new users, Singapore region (International deployment scope) only
providers.rate_limits: Per-model, account-level limits that apply equally to free-quota and paid calls (International): e.g. qwen-plus 600 RPM / 1,000,000 TPM; qwen-flash and qwen-turbo 600 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM; qwen3.6-plus and qwen3.7-plus 15,000 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM. HTTP 429 when a limit is exceeded; HTTP 403 when the free quota is exhausted
providers.notes: Covers real-time inference only; excludes batch invocation, fine-tuning, model deployment, custom models, PAI-DSW and OSS fees. Account information must be completed before activation. One quota per account (shared with RAM users); re-registering does not grant a new one.
providers.best_for: Qwen models with a large free token quota (Singapore region)

providers.name: Modal
providers.free_tier: $30/month recurring credit (Starter plan)
providers.rate_limits: Starter: 100 containers + 10 GPU concurrency, 5 crons, 1-day log retention
providers.notes: Recurring monthly credit, not a one-time trial. Modal is serverless compute you deploy models on, not a hosted model API. A payment method on file is required to use Modal at all.
providers.best_for: Self-hosting open models on free monthly GPU credit

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.free_tier: Rate-limited free tier (applies when no payment method is linked) across all models
providers.rate_limits: Free Tier: 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD across all models; Developer Tier (card required): 60-240 RPM depending on model
providers.notes: Free Tier applies when no payment method is linked to the account; SambaCloud ToS grants a commercial license (no evaluation-only clause). The previously-listed "$5 / 3 months" trial could not be re-confirmed on official pages (2026-07-30). card_required is unconfirmed because SambaNova's own pages disagree (read 2026-10-08): the rate-limits doc (https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits) says "Free Tier: Applied when there is no payment method linked with your account", while the plans page (https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans) says "Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests". Settling it needs a real signup, which is not done without the Owner's OK. The rate-limits doc (read 2026-10-09) also lists two preview models on the Free Tier at the same 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD (DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it), described there as having limited capacity and removable at short notice; they are not in models_free.
providers.best_for: Fast open models on a rate-limited free tier

free_limits.scope: Free Tier (no payment method linked), each of DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and gpt-oss-120b

providers.name: Scaleway Generative APIs
providers.free_tier: 1,000,000 tokens free + 60 min Whisper transcription; billing starts at token 1,000,001
providers.rate_limits: With a validated payment method: 300 RPM / 200k TPM per model; 600 RPM and higher TPM once identity is verified
providers.notes: European provider (France). Free allowance is a one-time token bucket, not time-limited. Official rate limits apply once a valid payment method is registered; identity verification raises them.
providers.best_for: EU-hosted open models with 1M free tokens

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.free_tier: Trial credit, phone verification required
providers.rate_limits: Up to 40 requests/min and 10,000 requests/day; limits may vary by model and traffic from other users may cause throttling
providers.notes: "Evaluation only, not production" per NVIDIA's own Trial Terms of Service — NVIDIA may discontinue the trial at any time with no continuity obligation
providers.best_for: Trialling NVIDIA-optimized models (evaluation only)

providers.name: Vercel AI Gateway
providers.free_tier: Free tier: a monthly free credit covering a subset of models (Free Tier eligible models) at lower rate limits
providers.rate_limits: No numeric free-tier limit published: the free tier has a lower per-model limit than paid (HTTP 429 when exceeded); Vercel documents behavior, not numbers
providers.notes: A monthly free credit is stated in Vercel's docs (https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/pricing, read 2026-10-09); the amount is not stated there. Once you purchase credits, your account moves to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies. BYOK is not available on the free tier. It routes requests to many providers rather than hosting models itself. models_free is a sample, not the full list: the first language model, by id, of each of the first eight providers in alphabetical order among the models flagged availableToFreeTier in the page data of https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models, joined with type language in https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models and excluding priority-tier variants (isFast) and the synthetic free copy (isSyntheticFreeTier) (131 such models from 30 providers, read 2026-10-09T03:00Z; the catalogue changes). We did not verify that the rendered ?freeTier=true filter matches that field. Five models priced at zero that spend no credit are tagged free in the API: convaiinnovations/laya, convaiinnovations/laya-free (evaluation type, not chat), inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash, inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-free and poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free.
providers.best_for: One key across many providers with a free monthly credit

providers.name: Jina AI
providers.free_tier: 10M free tokens (one-time) across all models — embeddings, rerankers, classifier; plus a keyless Reader (r.jina.ai) for basic use
providers.rate_limits: Free key: 100 RPM / 100k TPM for embeddings & reranker; Reader 20 RPM keyless, 500 RPM with a free key
providers.notes: The 10M-token balance is a one-time grant that does not replenish; the keyless Reader is genuinely ongoing. Hosted API is commercial-OK and data is not used for training. No card required.
providers.best_for: Free embeddings & rerank behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

providers.name: Deepgram
providers.free_tier: $200 free credit on signup (no card, no expiration) — Nova speech-to-text and Aura text-to-speech at pay-as-you-go rates
providers.rate_limits: STT pre-recorded up to 50 concurrent; STT streaming up to 150; TTS REST up to 15; TTS streaming up to 45
providers.notes: No card and no expiration on the credit. Data catch: the Model Improvement Program is opt-OUT — send mip_opt_out=true per request to keep your data out of training. Native REST/WebSocket API, not OpenAI-compatible.
providers.best_for: Biggest free credit here, for speech (STT/TTS)

providers.name: AssemblyAI
providers.free_tier: $50 free credit on signup (no card) — pre-recorded & streaming speech-to-text, Speech Understanding, and an OpenAI-compatible LLM Gateway (25+ models)
providers.rate_limits: Free tier: 5 parallel transcriptions; streaming 5 new streams/min; global 20k requests / 5 min
providers.notes: One-time credit, not renewing. Catch: the default model differs between free and paid accounts — set speech_models explicitly to avoid cost jumps on upgrade. Only the LLM Gateway is OpenAI-compatible.
providers.best_for: Free speech-to-text plus an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway

providers.name: Mixedbread
providers.free_tier: Starter plan: $5 one-time credit (no card) — embeddings (mxbai-embed-large-v1), reranking, and multimodal search over PDF/image/doc/code
providers.rate_limits: Starter plan: 100 requests/min
providers.notes: Free credit is usage-based and non-renewing; usage-based pricing applies afterward. Native REST API, not documented as OpenAI-compatible. No card required.
providers.best_for: No-card embeddings & rerank credit

providers.name: Clarifai
providers.free_tier: One-time $5 credit across serverless models (GPT-OSS-120B, Claude, Llama), vision, embeddings and image generation
providers.rate_limits: 15 requests/second global default (CONN_THROTTLED on exceed)
providers.notes: Could not be re-verified on 2026-10-08: docs.clarifai.com no longer resolves and www.clarifai.com does not respond. Nebius has announced that Clarifai's core team joined Nebius and that it licensed Clarifai's inference technology. Treat this entry as likely discontinued. Previously recorded: SMS phone verification to claim a one-time $5 credit that expired 30 days after grant.
providers.best_for: Multimodal (LLM + vision) models on a $5 credit

providers.name: Arli AI
providers.free_tier: Free plan ($0): text LLMs for testing, max 5 requests every 2 days per model, 12K context, 1 request at a time, delayed responses; no image generation
providers.rate_limits: 5 requests every 2 days per model; 1 request at a time; max 12K context tokens
providers.notes: Free tier is for testing only — very restrictive. Provider advertises zero-log / no data retention. Card requirement for the free tier is not stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: A permanently-free (heavily rate-limited) test tier

providers.name: Ollama Cloud
providers.free_tier: $0 Free plan: starter amount of cloud usage credits, limited to a smaller set of starter models; buying credits unlocks all cloud models
providers.rate_limits: 1 concurrent request on the free plan; included usage resets monthly from signup date (dollar amount of starter credits not published)
providers.notes: First-party — Ollama hosts the cloud models. Requires an ollama.com account + API key. The old 5-hour session / weekly limits are gone: usage is now credit-based with a monthly reset; Pro ($20/mo) includes $60 of credits. Prompts/responses are not logged or trained on. Whether a card is required is not stated on the current pricing page.
providers.best_for: Cloud-hosted open models with the Ollama workflow

providers.name: AI Horde
providers.free_tier: Free crowdsourced text & image generation; anonymous API key '0000000000' (no registration), or register to earn kudos for priority
providers.rate_limits: Queue-based priority via kudos (no fixed quota); anonymous requests get lowest priority under load
providers.notes: Community-powered volunteer network — model availability and speed vary with worker supply, so it is not a fixed-SLA service. No card, no phone. Kudos never expire and cannot be sold.
providers.best_for: Anonymous, no-signup free generation (variable speed)

providers.name: ModelScope (API-Inference)
providers.free_tier: Free API-Inference calls paid with daily 'Magicubes': 200/day for signing in + 50/day after linking an Alibaba Cloud account (do not roll over); calls cost ~0.5 / 1 / 2 Magicubes for lightweight / standard / flagship models
providers.rate_limits: Bounded by the daily Magicubes: ~250/day from signing in and linking an Alibaba Cloud account, plus any earned by other actions (~125-500 calls depending on model tier); concurrency dynamically limited, single concurrency guaranteed
providers.notes: Alibaba's model hub — a different product from Alibaba Model Studio. Requires a ModelScope account bound to an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name (ID) verification — a practical barrier for non-China users. Explicitly non-commercial ("for developers to experience"). No card.
providers.best_for: Free daily calls to many open models (Alibaba Cloud real-name verification required)

providers.name: Pollinations.ai
providers.free_tier: Quest Pollen: create an account, complete eligible Quests on the Quests dashboard and claim the rewards; Quest Pollen is spent before paid Pollen on regular (non-paid-only) models. No anonymous/no-key generation — every generation endpoint requires an API key and costs Pollen ($1 ≈ 1 Pollen). Text, image, video, audio, embeddings and 3D models behind one OpenAI-compatible API
providers.rate_limits: No per-request rate limits published for sk_ keys; usage is bounded by the Pollen balance (legacy raw pk_ keys: 1 Pollen per IP per hour)
providers.notes: The old anonymous 1 req/15s and Seed 1 req/5s tiers (and the watermark/nologo scheme) are gone from the current docs; the API moved to gen.pollinations.ai with keys from enter.pollinations.ai. Quest availability and reward amounts change ("the dashboard and the linked issue are the source of truth"). No credit card needed to try. Paid-only models require Paid Pollen. Commercial use is not explicitly addressed in the docs. The previous docs_url pointed at the stale master branch; the default branch is main.
providers.best_for: OpenAI-compatible multi-modal API funded by Quest Pollen (no card)

providers.name: Runware
providers.free_tier: $2 in free credits for new users who sign up with a business email, usable on the Models API (image, video, audio, LLM and 3D models) on the Sonic Inference Engine
providers.rate_limits: Per-organization REST rate limit counted in results per second (number not published; "sits far above typical traffic"); no hard concurrency limit (2-4 concurrent requests recommended)
providers.notes: The $2 requires signup with a business email; no credit card required. Commercial use of Outputs is allowed, subject to each model's licence (Partner Models are cleared for commercial use by Runware). Third-party provider models are subject to those providers' own rate limits.
providers.best_for: Fast image models with a $2 no-card credit

providers.name: Pinecone Inference
providers.free_tier: Starter (free) plan: 5M embedding tokens/month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0) and 500 rerank requests/month (bge-reranker-v2-m3; the rate-limits doc also lists pinecone-rerank-v0 at 500)
providers.rate_limits: Starter: 5M embedding tokens/mo per model; 250K embedding tokens/min per model (passage); 500 rerank requests/mo and 60 rerank requests/min per model; 100 inference requests/s and 2,000/min per project
providers.notes: Monthly limits are hard: reaching one returns 429 and you must upgrade (no pay-as-you-go overage on Starter). The pricing page lists only bge-reranker-v2-m3 as included on Starter while the rate-limits doc also lists pinecone-rerank-v0 at 500 — an internal inconsistency. Not OpenAI-compatible. Card requirement for Starter not stated on the pricing page or docs. No card was required at signup when last confirmed (2026-08); the current pages do not mention it.
providers.best_for: Free embeddings + rerank for RAG (5M tokens/mo per model)

free_limits.scope: Starter plan: 5M embedding tokens per month for each of llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large and pinecone-sparse-english-v0; 500 rerank requests per month for bge-reranker-v2-m3; Starter plan limits as listed on the pricing page, which Pinecone can change

providers.name: Twelve Labs (Marengo Embed)
providers.free_tier: Free plan: the Marengo 3.5 Embed API (video, audio, image, text and document inputs) and the Pegasus Analyze API at no cost, plus 600 minutes (10 hours) of video indexing in total
providers.rate_limits: Embed video/audio: 3,000 RPD, 25 RPM; embed text/image: 3,000 RPD, 600 RPM
providers.notes: No credit card for the Free plan, but indexed data expires after 90 days unless upgraded. Marengo produces multimodal embeddings. Not OpenAI-compatible.
providers.best_for: Free multimodal (video/audio/image/text) embeddings

free_limits.scope: Free plan, Embed API (Marengo 3.5): 3,000 requests per day for video, audio, image and text; 25 requests per minute for video and audio, 600 for image and text. Other APIs have their own limits

providers.name: OCR.space
providers.free_tier: 25,000 conversions/month (Engine 1 & 2) plus 1,000 Engine 3 conversions/month; max 1 MB file, PDFs up to 3 pages
providers.rate_limits: 500 requests per day per IP address
providers.notes: Free searchable-PDF output carries a watermark (raw text extraction is unrestricted); the free key needs only an email, no card. Commercial use permitted.
providers.best_for: Classic free OCR (25k conversions/mo, no card)

free_limits.scope: free OCR API key, per IP address

providers.name: LlamaParse (LlamaCloud)
providers.free_tier: Free plan: 10,000 credits/month (up to ~10,000 pages at the cheapest parse tier, as low as 1 credit/page)
providers.rate_limits: 5 concurrent jobs; 1 project; 5 indexes on the free plan
providers.notes: Credit-based (1,000 credits = $1.25); premium parse modes consume more credits per page. No card required. Document parsing for RAG (LlamaIndex).
providers.best_for: Free document parsing for RAG (~10k pages/mo)

providers.name: Nanonets
providers.free_tier: $50 in free credits on signup (one-time) across data-extraction / OCR workflows
providers.rate_limits: Not published by the provider
providers.notes: One-time signup credit, not renewing (credits never expire); no credit card required to start. Paid plans start at $100/month afterwards.
providers.best_for: Document extraction on a $50 no-card credit

providers.name: Moondream Cloud
providers.free_tier: $5/month usage credits in every workspace (Free plan) for the Moondream vision model — caption, query (VQA), detect, point
providers.rate_limits: 2 requests/sec on the free tier (10 req/sec with ≥$10 account balance); usage bounded by the $5/month credit
providers.notes: Recurring $5/month credit, no credit card required. Per the Terms (§5.2), data is not used to train Moondream's generally available models. Commercial terms for the hosted API not specified. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providers.best_for: Tiny vision model, OpenAI-compatible, monthly free credit

providers.name: Speechmatics
providers.free_tier: Free plan: $100 credit grant on signup (no payment card) for Speech-to-Text; Text-to-Speech lists the first 1 million characters free
providers.rate_limits: Free: 2 concurrent real-time sessions; Batch API: 10 new jobs/s and 50 job-status requests/s (bounded by the $100 credit)
providers.notes: One-time $100 credit grant, no card required; to go beyond it, add a card and move to Pro (pay-as-you-go). Accounts created before 1 August 2026 received a one-time $25 transition credit. No data logging for model training by default. Commercial-use permission not explicitly stated.
providers.best_for: High-accuracy STT + TTS on a $100 no-card credit

providers.name: Speechify API
providers.free_tier: 500K characters/month TTS (hard cap; pauses until next month), catalog voices, streaming and SSML
providers.rate_limits: Free: 3 concurrent requests, 1 request/s sustained (burst 10); hard monthly cap, no top-ups
providers.notes: Commercial use is allowed on the free tier. No credit card required. Free cannot top up and pauses when the monthly balance runs out. Voice cloning is paid-plan only; voice agents are now an enterprise-only product (no free minutes).
providers.best_for: Free commercial TTS (500K chars/mo)

providers.name: Hume AI (Octave TTS)
providers.free_tier: Free tier for Octave TTS and EVI; new accounts start with $20 in credits
providers.rate_limits: Rate set by subscription tier, numbers not published; max 5,000 characters per utterance and 5 generations per request
providers.notes: Free and Starter tiers are non-commercial only (commercial use starts on Creator). The Free plan cannot buy overage, so going past it means upgrading. Not OpenAI-compatible. The former plan quota (10,000 characters/month) is no longer on a live official page: hume.ai/pricing redirected to the homepage on 2026-10-08.
providers.best_for: Expressive TTS to prototype with (the free tier is non-commercial)

providers.name: Unreal Speech
providers.free_tier: 250,000 characters/month TTS (~6 hours of audio)
providers.rate_limits: No rate limit published in the current V8 API docs (legacy v7 docs listed 2 requests/second on Free). Per-request size: /stream up to 1,000 characters, /speech up to 3,000, /synthesisTasks up to 500,000
providers.notes: Commercial use allowed, but free-plan users must attribute Unreal Speech with a link when publishing audio. First-party REST endpoints. No credit card required.
providers.best_for: Largest free TTS (250k chars/mo, attribution)

providers.name: ElevenLabs
providers.free_tier: 10,000 credits/month shared across Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text and more (~10 min TTS/month)
providers.rate_limits: 2 concurrent requests on the Free plan
providers.notes: The free tier is NON-COMMERCIAL only per the Terms of Use (commercial license starts on paid Starter, $6/mo); non-commercial use requires a personal email address. Free-plan credits do not roll over. API access is available on the free plan. No credit card to sign up.
providers.best_for: Best-known TTS voices (free tier is non-commercial)

providers.name: Sarvam AI
providers.free_tier: ₹100 in free credits on signup, usable across any API including chat completion (Sarvam-105B) and speech (STT/TTS); credits never expire
providers.rate_limits: Starter plan: 40 req/min for chat with Sarvam-105B (60 for other default models), STT REST and TTS REST (bulbul:v3: 30 req/min); 20 concurrent STT WebSocket streams; bounded by the ₹100 credit
providers.notes: One-time signup credit shared across all APIs; credits never expire. Sarvam-M has been deprecated (use Sarvam-105B). Signup credits carry commercial production rights for generated Output. Card/phone requirement not stated in the docs. The docs list limits per plan but do not say explicitly that free-credit accounts are on Starter. India-focused provider (pricing in INR), strong Indic-language models.
providers.best_for: Indic-language chat + speech via one OpenAI-compatible key

providers.name: Gladia
providers.free_tier: €50 in free credits on signup for speech-to-text (~80+ hrs pre-recorded or 60+ hrs real-time at current rates)
providers.rate_limits: 30 real-time and 25 async concurrent requests (Starter pay-as-you-go plan that carries the €50 credit)
providers.notes: One-time grant with no monthly reset; prepaid model — top up once the credit is consumed. Card requirement not explicitly stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: High-accuracy async + real-time transcription to trial

providers.name: Rime
providers.free_tier: Free minutes for every new account (Starter plan): the pricing card says ~800 minutes (~800k characters), while the FAQ and docs say 3,000
providers.rate_limits: Starter: 20 concurrent TTS generations
providers.notes: One-time allotment on signup; no credit card required (stated on the pricing page). The pricing table shows ~800 free minutes (~800k characters) while the page’s own FAQ and the docs still say 3,000 — an internal inconsistency. Commercial-use terms not stated.
providers.best_for: Low-latency conversational TTS to prototype

providers.name: Tencent Hunyuan
providers.free_tier: One-time free package on first activation: 1,000,000 tokens shared across Hunyuan text/vision models (Hunyuan-a13b, Hunyuan-role-latest, Hunyuan-translation, Hunyuan-translation-lite, Tencent HY Vision 1.5 Instruct, Hunyuan-turbos-vision, Hunyuan-t1-vision, Hunyuan-turbos-vision-video), plus a separate 1,000,000 tokens for Hunyuan-embedding
providers.rate_limits: ChatCompletions (Tencent Cloud API): default 5 concurrent requests per account; GetEmbedding: 5 requests/second (both marked pre-offline, expected 2026-12-21). A limit of 20 requests/second for the other Hunyuan APIs is not stated on any official API page checked on 2026-10-08, so it is not confirmed
providers.notes: Free resource package valid 1 year from activation; unused tokens expire, and it does not roll into pay-as-you-go automatically. Activation requires Tencent Cloud real-name verification (enterprise or personal) — a practical barrier for many non-China users. Tencent says Hunyuan is migrating to TokenHub: the legacy platform will add no new models and stops supporting new model-service purchases; the legacy ChatCompletions and GetEmbedding APIs are marked pre-offline with expected shutdown 2026-12-21 (the OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the documented alternative), and the same API page (updated 2026-09-23) says the old Hunyuan console goes offline on 30 September. Whether new activations still receive the free package after the migration is not stated. Commercial-use terms not stated on the free-quota page.
providers.best_for: Chinese-language LLM workloads via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

providers.name: Voyage AI
providers.free_tier: 200M free tokens per model on current embedding models (voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4, voyage-code-4) and on the rerankers listed in the price table (rerank-3, rerank-3-lite); voyage-multimodal-3.5 and voyage-multimodal-3 get 200M text tokens + 150B pixels; legacy voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2 get 50M — a one-time complimentary allotment per account
providers.rate_limits: No numeric limit published for accounts without a payment method. With a payment method (Tier 1, free tokens still apply), per model: voyage-4 / voyage-code-4 8M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-large / voyage-context-4 3M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-lite 16M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-multimodal-3.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3 / rerank-2.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3-lite / rerank-2.5-lite 4M TPM, 2,000 RPM. HTTP 429 on exceed
providers.notes: The allotment is a one-time complimentary balance per model, not a renewing monthly quota. Free tokens do not apply to Batch API usage. Voyage's pricing page is internally inconsistent on rerankers: the prose still names the rerank-2.5/rerank-2 families as free, while the price table gives 200M free tokens to rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite and lists rerank-2.5 under older models with no free tokens. No credit card required to claim. Owned by MongoDB — a first-party model provider, not a proxy.
providers.best_for: Best-in-class embeddings and reranking with a large free allotment

providers.name: Contextual AI
providers.free_tier: $25 in free credits on the on-demand plan, usable on the Rerank (rerank-v2) and Generate APIs
providers.rate_limits: Not published by the provider (Rerank requests capped at 400,000 tokens each)
providers.notes: One-time signup credit (does not renew); the instruction-following reranker is the standout free capability. Commercial-use terms not stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: A strong instruction-following reranker to try for free

providers.name: Cartesia
providers.free_tier: 20,000 credits/month (~27 min of Sonic TTS or ~1h51 of Ink speech-to-text)
providers.rate_limits: 2 concurrent TTS requests, 8 concurrent STT; 20,000 credits/month
providers.notes: Commercial use is NOT allowed on the free plan (the $5/mo Pro plan adds a commercial licence). Low-latency streaming voice over WebSocket/REST; own API (not OpenAI-shaped).
providers.best_for: Low-latency streaming TTS + STT on a renewing monthly free quota

providers.name: Fish Audio
providers.free_tier: App Free plan: 8,000 credits/month (~7 min, up to 500 characters per generation). API: the s2.1-pro-free TTS model is $0 through 2026-11-30 under fair-use limits (pay-as-you-go API, no subscription)
providers.rate_limits: API: 5 concurrent requests (Starter tier, <$100 paid); s2.1-pro-free under unpublished fair-use limits. App Free plan: 500 characters per generation, 8,000 credits/month
providers.notes: Free app plan is personal, non-commercial only (commercial use requires Premium). The $0 API model s2.1-pro-free is pitched for testing, prototyping and smaller businesses but has no TTFA/DPA guarantees. No credit card required for the Free plan.
providers.best_for: Free multilingual TTS with voice cloning for personal projects

providers.name: Camb.ai
providers.free_tier: Free plan: 5,000 credits one-time (no monthly renewal) across TTS, dubbing, speech and translation tools
providers.rate_limits: Not published by the provider; bounded by the one-time 5,000-credit grant
providers.notes: Uses its own MARS voice models (not OpenAI-compatible). Free credits are a one-time grant, not monthly. Per-feature limits (characters per generation, watermarking) are not readable on the current pricing page. Card and commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: Expressive multilingual TTS, STT and dubbing on one free quota

providers.name: Rev AI
providers.free_tier: Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR (speech-to-text), usable across all Rev AI products
providers.rate_limits: Bounded by the 5-hour credit grant
providers.notes: Free credits granted at signup (renewal/expiry not stated). High-accuracy English ASR. No credit card required (stated on the signup page). Commercial terms not stated.
providers.best_for: 5 free hours of high-accuracy speech-to-text to evaluate

providers.name: Unstructured
providers.free_tier: 10,000 free pages once per account — document parsing/OCR (layout, tables, generative OCR enrichment); then $0.015/page pay-as-you-go
providers.rate_limits: No public request-rate or concurrency limits for the Transform API; one document per request, 50 MB per document; free allotment 10,000 pages in total
providers.notes: No credit card required. The free pages are a one-time credit per account (not monthly); after 10,000 pages, processing requests fail until you upgrade to Pay-As-You-Go. Purpose-built to turn documents into clean, structured input for RAG/LLM pipelines. Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: Turning messy documents into LLM-ready structured data (10,000 free pages to start)

providers.name: Nutrient (Data Extraction API)
providers.free_tier: 5,000 credits/month (renews; no rollover) — ~5,000 text-parse pages, fewer for OCR-heavy 'Understand'/'Agentic' parsing (9-18 credits/page)
providers.rate_limits: 5,000 credits/month; Parse costs 1-18 credits/page by mode (Extract 7-24)
providers.notes: No credit card required. Formerly PSPDFKit. Extraction/OCR with tables, key-value and handwriting. Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.
providers.best_for: Document data extraction with a genuinely renewing free monthly quota

providers.name: Photoroom
providers.free_tier: 10 free production calls on the Remove Background API (one-time) plus 1,000 sandbox calls/month on the Image Editing API (watermarked)
providers.rate_limits: 1,000 sandbox calls/month; 10 one-time production calls
providers.notes: No credit card required. Sandbox output is watermarked (for testing); the 10 production calls return clean output. Image editing/generation (AI backgrounds, relighting, shadows).
providers.best_for: Programmatic background removal and AI image editing to prototype free

providers.name: Poolside
providers.free_tier: Free developer API key via Poolside Platform for Poolside's Laguna coding models (current lineup: Laguna S 2.1, Laguna XS 2.1, Laguna M.1); which models and limits apply to the free key is not documented
providers.rate_limits: Not published
providers.notes: Coding-focused models. Docs describe Poolside Platform as "fast, free developer access"; paid access with a larger context window is via OpenRouter. The earlier 'free for a limited time' wording no longer appears in the current docs, and no end date is published. Self-serve key at platform.poolside.ai. No card was required at signup when last confirmed (2026-08); the current pages do not mention it.
providers.best_for: Free coding-focused LLMs behind an OpenAI-compatible key

providers.name: Upstage
providers.free_tier: $10 free credit on sign-up (per Upstage's Getting Started docs) for the API — Solar LLM (chat + embeddings) plus Document Parse / OCR / information extraction; Studio document agents include 10 free runs each
providers.rate_limits: Tier 0 (below the Explore commitment tier): Solar Pro 4 100 RPM / 250,000 TPM; Solar Mini 4 100 RPM / 50,000 TPM; Embeddings 100 RPM / 300,000 TPM; Document OCR 3 requests/second, 500 pages/minute
providers.notes: The Solar Pro 4 free window (2026-08-05 to 2026-08-11) has ended; standard pricing is $0.30 input / $1.20 output per 1M tokens from 2026-10-11 (UTC), after a 70%-off phase that runs until 2026-10-10. Beyond the signup credit, API use is pay-per-use, with prepaid commitment tiers from $100/mo adding bonus credit and higher limits. Studio agent runs need no card. A separate institutional grant (up to 1 year of free Solar Pro + Document Parse) exists for eligible schools, hospitals and nonprofits only. Solar Pro 2/3 and Solar Mini are deprecated on 2026-10-30 (KST).
providers.best_for: Solar LLM + document OCR behind one OpenAI-compatible key

providers.name: Veryfi
providers.free_tier: Free Forever plan: up to 100 documents/month — OCR plus structured data extraction (receipts, invoices, and 100+ document types)
providers.rate_limits: 100 documents/month on the free plan
providers.notes: No credit card required. The 'Free Forever' 100 docs/mo tier is the standing free tier (a separate 14-day trial unlocks paid features). Proprietary OCR / document-intelligence REST API.
providers.best_for: Free-forever document OCR (100 docs/mo, no card)

providers.name: Voicegain
providers.free_tier: $50 in free credits on signup (no credit card) — speech-to-text
providers.rate_limits: Default for new accounts: 75 API requests/minute and 2,000/hour; 4 concurrent real-time ASR requests; OFF-LINE transcription up to 4 hours of audio per hour (queue of 10 jobs)
providers.notes: No credit card required to start — an explicit $50 platform credit on signup; afterwards cloud STT is billed at $0.00020/second of audio (6-second minimum per request). Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page. Native STT REST API. The former /pricing URL now redirects to /developers.
providers.best_for: Largest no-card speech-to-text credit ($50)

providers.name: Smallest.ai (Waves)
providers.free_tier: $10 in free credits with full access on Pay As You Go — TTS (Lightning v3.1), STT (Pulse) and voice agents; speech-to-speech (Hydra) is beta/request-access
providers.rate_limits: Pay As You Go: 15 concurrent TTS streams, 100 TTS requests/min, 450M chars/month cap; 100 concurrent STT streams; 20 concurrent agent calls (bounded by the $10 credit)
providers.notes: $10 starting credit on Pay As You Go. The models pricing page lists 15 concurrent TTS streams while the API reference still says 1 active TTS request per account — inconsistent. The models table shows Voice Cloning 'No' for Pay As You Go although the TTS card advertises instant cloning. Card and commercial terms not stated. /pricing now redirects to /pricing/agents.
providers.best_for: Fast TTS + STT on a $10 credit

providers.name: Retell AI
providers.free_tier: $10 in free trial credits (once per email address) plus 20 concurrent calls included — voice-agent orchestration (STT + LLM + TTS)
providers.rate_limits: 20 concurrent calls per workspace (Pay-As-You-Go default)
providers.notes: $10 trial credit with full platform access, granted once per email address. A payment method is required only to buy phone numbers or use the service beyond the free trial. A voice-agent builder (orchestration), not a raw model API. Voice agents cost ~$0.07-$0.31/min after the credit.
providers.best_for: Build a voice agent on a $10 no-card trial credit

providers.name: Datalab (Marker / Surya)
providers.free_tier: $20/month (work email) or $10/month (personal email) free usage allowance — OCR in 90+ languages, PDF-to-markdown, tables, forms and structured extraction
providers.rate_limits: 10 requests/min and 5 concurrent requests on the free tier; per-page pricing (see datalab.to/pricing)
providers.notes: Landing page still advertises a $5 signup credit, but the billing page describes the current free tier as a recurring monthly allowance ($20/mo work email, $10/mo personal, no card, 25 req/min) “designed to let you run a complete proof of concept before committing to a paid plan” — no explicit statement on commercial use of the hosted API. The self-hosted OSS weights carry a separate restriction (research/personal/startups under $2M ARR/funding). Signup does not require a phone number; checked via Google signup flow on 2026-10-02.
providers.best_for: Open-source-pedigree OCR (Marker/Surya) on a free monthly allowance

providers.name: W&B Inference
providers.free_tier: Serverless Inference credits on the Free plan "for a limited time" (amount not published); Free accounts have a default spending cap of $100/month
providers.rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published; per-project and per-user concurrency limits (HTTP 429 when exceeded); default spending cap $100/month on the Free tier
providers.notes: W&B Inference is now documented as CoreWeave Forge Serverless Inference (docs.wandb.ai redirects to docs.coreweave.com). The $100/month figure is a default spending cap, not a stated free-credit amount. When credits run out, Free accounts must activate pay-as-you-go on the Billing tab or upgrade; CoreWeave requires prepayment for paid access. Available only from supported geographic locations. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.inference.wandb.ai/v1; API keys are created at forge.coreweave.com. The pricing page lists "$5/mo free credit for a limited time" only under Pro and "Billed monthly" under Free, so the Free amount is unclear.
providers.best_for: Open-weight frontier models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, GLM, GPT-OSS) behind one unified API with Weave tracing

providers.name: Typhoon (SCB 10X)
providers.free_tier: Free to use research showcase API — all Typhoon models at $0
providers.rate_limits: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct: 5 requests/second, 200 requests/minute; typhoon-ocr: 2 requests/second, 20 requests/minute; typhoon-asr-realtime: 100 requests/minute
providers.notes: By SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank, focused on Thai-language models. The free catalog spans LLMs (typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct), OCR (typhoon-ocr family) and realtime Thai ASR (typhoon-asr-realtime, typhoon-isan-asr-realtime) — the hosted API is OpenAI-compatible, including audio transcriptions. Beta, provided as-is with no formal support; usage data is collected to improve the model; SCB claims no rights in outputs. Sign up for a free API key at opentyphoon.ai.
providers.best_for: Thai-language LLMs, OCR and speech via an OpenAI-compatible research API
